description: Hae-soo used to be a reporter for the City Department, who read a proper life and enjoyed helping those in need through his articles. That is…until he was transferred to the Entertainment Department and became the worst performing reporter there. As he felt more and more desperate to come up with a good story, his former colleague hooked him up with the tickets to an after party, where he met the hottest celebrity, Kang Min-woo. During the party Min-woo takes interest in Hae-soo and makes him an interesting proposition that could potentially benefit the both of them. However as Hae-soo begins to help Min-woo and go along with his plans, he can’t help but feel that Min-woo wants more than just an acting partner. Hae-soo can’t turn Min-woo down because he needs the scoop! What does Min-woo want with Hae-soo? How will Hae-soo protect his life between his crumbling job and his shady informant?
